[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=Shadow's Passage | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=232 }} [[Shadow's Passage]] is a narrow passage below the palace. It only functions as the route between [[Bukdek Byway]] and [[Dragon's Throat (outpost)|Dragon's Throat]]. ==Getting there== Exit from [[Dragon's Throat (outpost)|Dragon's Throat]], or travel through [[Bukdek Byway]] ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s with a [[statue]]: *[[Champion of Balthazar]] **East, near the exit to [[Dragon's Throat (outpost)|Dragon's Throat]] *[[Lyssa's Muse]] **West, near the exit to [[Bukdek Byway]] ==NPCs== ===Foes=== [[Afflicted]] *{{w}} 20 (26) [[Afflicted Warrior]] *{{r}} 20 (26) [[Afflicted Ranger]] *{{mo}} 20 (26) [[Afflicted Monk]] *{{n}} 20 (26) [[Afflicted Necromancer]] *{{me}} 20 (26) [[Afflicted Mesmer]] *{{e}} 20 (26) [[Afflicted Elementalist]] *{{a}} 20 (26) [[Afflicted Assassin]] *{{rt}} 20 (26) [[Afflicted Ritualist]] [[Human]]s ([[Jade Brotherhood]]) *{{w}} 20 (26) [[Jade Brotherhood Knight]] *{{me}} 20 (26) [[Jade Brotherhood Mesmer]] *{{e}} 20 (26) [[Jade Brotherhood Mage]] *{{rt}} 20 (26) [[Jade Brotherhood Ritualist]] ====Bosses==== [[Afflicted]] *{{w}} 24 (30) [[The Afflicted Ako]] → [[Enraged Smash]] ==Notes== *These quests will affect the [[spawn]]s in this area: **[[Finding The Oracle]] *[[Interactive object]]s **[[Canthan Chest]] ([[chest]]) *This area always contains one [[chest]]. When entering the area from Bukdek Byway, the chest most often spawns near Afflicted, otherwise you'll find it near Jade Brotherhood. *{{Vanquisher|count = 14|low = 6|high = 39}} **If starting from Dragon's Throat it is possible to vanquish only the Afflicted groups, The Afflicted Ako and one small spawn before him, by pulling them closer so you are never within range for the Jade Brotherhood to spawn.
